diagram_previews.alt: A horizontal blue river; the point you (0,2) above it and the cabin (3,4) further up and to the right. The shortest route goes from you down to the red point R on the river and then up to the cabin; the dashed extension from R continues to the reflected cabin (3,-4) below the river, and a dotted vertical line joins the cabin to its reflection.

difficulty_rationale: One accessible observation or a short chain of familiar deductions.
